name: The Dragon-Kami Reborn // Dragon-Kami's Egg
text: (As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)\nI, II — You gain 2 life. Look at the top three cards of your library. rulings: [{'date': '2022-02-18', 'text': 'A transforming double-faced card enters the battlefield with its front face up by default, unless a spell or ability instructs you to put it onto the battlefield transformed or you cast it transformed, in which case it enters with its back face up.'}, {'date': '2022-02-18', 'text': "Each face of a transforming double-faced card has its own set of characteristics: name, types, subtypes, abilities, and so on. The other set of characteristics is ignored."}, {'date': '2022-02-18', 'text': "Each transforming double-faced card in this set is cast face up. If it is on the battlefield, consider only the characteristics of the face that's up; the other face's characteristics are ignored."}, {'date': '2022-02-18', 'text': "If Dragon-Kami's Egg and one or more Dragons you control die at the same time, the ability of Dragon-Kami's Egg will trigger once for each of them. text: When Kotose, the Silent Spider enters the battlefield, exile target card other than a basic land card from an opponent's graveyard. name: Eater of Virtue
text:
Whenever equipped creature dies, exile it.
Equipped creature gets +2/+0.
As long as a card exiled with Eater of Virtue has flying, equipped creature has flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, protection, reach, trample, and vigilance.
Equip {1}
